history.body: Hi, I work around Perai and saw your Seberang Jaya ad. Is this location convenient for daily travel?

Pearl Residences is in Seberang Jaya, with connectivity across the mainland urban network, including toward Chai Leng Park and Butterworth. It could be a practical base for work around Perai, though your exact daily journey depends on where you’re heading and the route—so I wouldn’t want to guess a travel time. Which part of Perai do you usually travel to?
Mostly around central Perai, though I move around a bit for work. Are there groceries or food options nearby for after work?

The project materials describe connectivity toward Chai Leng Park and Sunway Carnival Mall, but I don’t have a verified list of nearby grocery or food options or their distances, so I don’t want to guess. I can check which options are closest for after-work errands.
Okay, that helps. What are the monthly maintenance and other ongoing costs like? I’m trying to keep the total manageable.

Maintenance is RM0.18 per sq.ft., inclusive of the sinking fund. I don’t have verified figures for the other ongoing charges, so I’ll check rather than guess and get you a clearer picture of what to budget beyond maintenance.
At 900 sq ft, that works out to about RM162 a month for maintenance. Okay, please check the other ongoing charges too so I can get a clearer idea of the total.

Yes, that’s right: the maintenance is estimated at RM162 per month for 900 sq.ft., based on RM0.18 per sq.ft. and subject to confirmation. The other ongoing charges are still being checked; I’ll share the verified figures when available.
